MAIN_self_correction_20260812_1630: I recomputed a verdict that ALREADY EXISTED. The earlier file has the SAME numbers (triviaqa sd 0.30229201489958313 / bound 0.5096228584343542; popqa sd 0.33279470298495434 / bound 0.5610462051514753) so the arithmetic is corroborated by two independent computations -- but it is ALSO STRICTLY MORE COMPLETE than mine: it carries a chi-squared 95% CI on sigma_run per axis, which I did not compute. That sensitivity matters and I missed it: at the UPPER bound of sigma's CI, popqa's bound rises to 3.526 pp vs delta 1.3205 -> it WOULD exceed, and the file records n_decision_axes_exceeding_at_sigma_ci_hi = 1 with axes_exceeding_at_sigma_ci_hi = ['popqa']. So 'K2 does not fire' is a POINT-ESTIMATE verdict; with only df=2 the sigma estimate is so imprecise that one decision axis flips at the CI's upper end. K2 still does not fire under the pre-registered rule (which is stated on the point estimate), but the honest report must carry this fragility. USE THE EARLIER FILE as canonical.
